turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[Compress to floor content]
    C --> D[Report residue, evaporation, operative sentence, and finding]
    D --> E[This is a finding, not a draft.]

    B -->|Draft prompt| F{Mode stated or inferable?}
    F -->|No| G[Ask for mode]
    G --> F
    F -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| H[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]
    H -->|Gaps| I[Ask up to three questions or state assumptions]
    I --> H
    H -->|Pass| J[Compress the prompt]
    J --> K{Cut removed specification?}
    K -->|Yes| L[Revert the destructive cut]
    L --> J
    K -->|No| M{Two consecutive empty cuts?}
    M -->|No| N{Floor still passes?}
    N -->|No| O[Return the last passing version]
    O --> P[Output the contract]
    N -->|Yes| P
    M -->|Yes| P
    P --> Q[Ask the gate question]

    Q -->|Keep negotiating| J
    Q -->|Human freezes and executes| R{Execution tools available?}
    R -->|No| S[Gate stays closed]
    R -->|Yes| T[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    T --> U{Result}
    U -->|Success| V[Done]
    U -->|Floor item fails| W[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    W --> J
```
